typescript-6_0_3.text: {"actionRequired":false,"notesJudgeable":false,"title":"These 6.0.3 notes only point elsewhere, so the changes cannot be judged from them.","keyPoints":[{"text":"The release announcement blog post is where the actual release notes are.","quote":"For release notes, check out the [release announcement blog post](https://devblogs.microsoft.com/typescript/announcing-typescript-6-0/)."},{"text":"A GitHub issues query lists the fixes milestoned for 6.0.3.","quote":"[fixed issues query for TypeScript 6.0.3 (Stable)](https://github.com/Microsoft/TypeScript/issues?utf8=%E2%9C%93&q=milestone%3A%22TypeScript+6.0.3%22)"},{"text":"Downloads are published on npm.","quote":"Downloads are available on:"}],"breakingChanges":[]}

tailwindcss-4_3_0.text: {"actionRequired":false,"notesJudgeable":true,"title":"Adds container-size, scrollbar, zoom and tab utilities, plus new @variant forms and several fixes.","keyPoints":[{"text":"Adds `@container-size` and several new utilities, including `zoom-*` and `tab-*`.","quote":"Add `@container-size` utility"},{"text":"Adds `scrollbar-*` utilities for width, color and gutter, plus `scrollbar-gutter-*`.","quote":"Add `scrollbar-{auto,thin,none}` utilities for `scrollbar-width`"},{"text":"`@variant` now accepts stacked variants such as `hover:focus` and compound variants such as `hover, focus`.","quote":"Allow using `@variant` with compound variants"},{"text":"Fixes `@tailwindcss/vite` so CSS files containing `@variant` are processed.","quote":"Ensure CSS files containing `@variant` are processed by `@tailwindcss/vite`"},{"text":"Fixes canonicalization of arbitrary values, including units and `:has()` variants.","quote":"Canonicalization: preserve the original unit in arbitrary values instead of normalizing to base units"}],"breakingChanges":[]}

eslint-10_11_0.text: {"actionRequired":false,"notesJudgeable":true,"title":"ESLint 10.11.0 improves several rules and fixes __proto__ handling; no breaking changes are listed.","keyPoints":[{"text":"The `no-unsafe-finally` rule now reports unsafe labeled `continue` statements.","quote":"feat: report unsafe labeled `continue` in `no-unsafe-finally` rule (#21316) (electrohyun)"},{"text":"`new-cap` only exempts built-ins that reference the global.","quote":"feat: only exempt `new-cap` built-ins that reference the global (#21290) (sethamus)"},{"text":"`object-shorthand` no longer reports `__proto__` properties.","quote":"fix: don't report `__proto__` properties in `object-shorthand` (#21310) (xbinaryx)"},{"text":"`prefer-object-spread` ignores `__proto__` properties.","quote":"fix: ignore `__proto__` properties in `prefer-object-spread` (#21311) (xbinaryx)"},{"text":"`object-shorthand` handles quoted properties for `ignoreConstructors`.","quote":"feat: object-shorthand handle quoted properties for `ignoreConstructors` (#21271) (Pavel)"}],"breakingChanges":[]}

react-19_2_0.text: {"actionRequired":true,"notesJudgeable":true,"title":"Adds Activity, useEffectEvent and partial pre-rendering resume APIs, plus a reconciler parameter reorder.","keyPoints":[{"text":"`<Activity>` is a new API to hide and restore the UI and internal state of its children.","quote":"A new API to hide and restore the UI and internal state of its children."},{"text":"`useEffectEvent` extracts non-reactive logic out of Effects.","quote":"is a React Hook that lets you extract non-reactive logic into an"},{"text":"New resume APIs support partial pre-rendering with Web Streams and Node Streams, and `prerender` now returns a `postponed` state.","quote":"Added resume APIs for partial pre-rendering with Web Streams:"},{"text":"React DOM batches Suspense boundary reveals, matching client side rendering, which is most noticeable when animating reveals.","quote":"React DOM now batches suspense boundary reveals, matching the behavior of client side rendering."},{"text":"Node Web Streams (`prerender`, `renderToReadableStream`) are now available for server-side rendering on Node.js.","quote":"Add Node Web Streams (`prerender`, `renderToReadableStream`) to server-side-rendering APIs for Node.js"}],"breakingChanges":[{"change":"`createContainer` and `createHydrationContainer` have a different parameter order, so calls written for the old order need updating.","migration":"The notes give no migration steps. Check every call to `createContainer` and `createHydrationContainer` in your custom reconciler code and match the new parameter order after the `on*` handlers.","quote":"had their parameter order adjusted after `on*` handlers to account for upcoming experimental APIs"}]}

zod-4_6_5.text: {"actionRequired":false,"notesJudgeable":true,"title":"Zod 4.6.5 is a patch release: instanceof properties typing changes, currencyCode returns, and docs updates.","keyPoints":[{"text":"The `.properties()` shape for `instanceof` schemas now follows the instance type.","quote":"feat(instanceof): key the .properties() shape off the instance type (#6600)"},{"text":"`z.currencyCode()` is back after its revert was itself reverted.","quote":"Revert \"Revert \"feat: add z.currencyCode() over a vendored ISO 4217 list, refreshed weekly by CI (#6595)\"\""},{"text":"The properties section of the docs now leads with the check and adds a Zod Mini tab.","quote":"docs: lead the properties section with the check and add a Zod Mini tab (#6598)"},{"text":"The integration peers are re-pinned to the workspace zod after the 4.6.5 bump.","quote":"chore: re-pin the integration peers to the workspace zod after the 4.6.5 bump"}],"breakingChanges":[]}

prisma-7_10_0.text: {"actionRequired":false,"notesJudgeable":true,"title":"Adds @prisma/prisma7 so Prisma 7 can run beside Prisma 8, and secures Prisma Studio's local server.","keyPoints":[{"text":"The `@prisma/prisma7` package lets Prisma 7 CLI and configuration run alongside Prisma 8 in one project.","quote":"This release introduces `@prisma/prisma7`, a compatibility package that lets you retain a matching Prisma 7 CLI and configuration while installing Prisma 8 in the same project."},{"text":"Prisma Studio's local HTTP server now binds to `127.0.0.1` instead of all network interfaces.","quote":"Binds explicitly to `127.0.0.1` instead of all network interfaces."},{"text":"`P2002` errors from nested writes now report the correct model name, including mapped models.","quote":"Fixed `P2002` errors from nested writes so `meta.modelName` identifies the model where the unique constraint violation occurred, including models using `@@map` and `@@schema`."},{"text":"Parameter-chunked statements now run atomically and roll back if a later chunk fails.","quote":"Parameter-chunked statements are now executed atomically in a transaction and rolled back if a later chunk fails."},{"text":"PostgreSQL deadlocks are now reported as `P2034` transaction write conflicts.","quote":"PostgreSQL deadlocks using SQLSTATE `40P01` are now reported as `P2034` transaction write conflicts."}],"breakingChanges":[]}

vitest-5_0_1.text: {"actionRequired":false,"notesJudgeable":true,"title":"Patch release fixing vitest list exit codes, automocking, cache clearing and fake timers.","keyPoints":[{"text":"`vitest list` now exits with code 1 when test collection fails.","quote":"Exit 1 when vitest list fails collection"},{"text":"Automocking no longer hits a recursive prototype problem.","quote":"Avoid recursive prototype in automocking"},{"text":"Clearing the cache keeps the metadata file.","quote":"Keep metadata file when clearing the cache"},{"text":"`queueMicrotask` and `nextTick` are forced into `toNotFake`, so fake timers handle them correctly.","quote":"Force `queueMicrotask` and `nextTick` in `toNotFake`"},{"text":"A new focused trace view layout mode is added to the UI.","quote":"Add focused trace view layout mode"}],"breakingChanges":[]}

tailwindcss-4_2_4.text: {"actionRequired":false,"notesJudgeable":true,"title":"Tailwind CSS 4.2.4 is a patch fixing Vite alias imports in `@import` and `@plugin` with `@tailwindcss/vite`.","keyPoints":[{"text":"Imports in `@import` and `@plugin` resolve again when Vite aliases are used with `@tailwindcss/vite`.","quote":"Ensure imports in `@import` and `@plugin` still resolve correctly when using Vite aliases in `@tailwindcss/vite`"},{"text":"The only listed change is a bug fix, and the notes list no new features."},{"text":"The notes state no breaking changes, but they cover only one fix, so check your own build after upgrading."}],"breakingChanges":[]}

react-19_0_0.text: {"actionRequired":true,"notesJudgeable":true,"title":"React 19 adds Actions and new hooks, but removes long-deprecated APIs such as propTypes and ReactDOM.render.","keyPoints":[{"text":"`startTransition` now accepts async functions, so Transitions can include side effects such as `fetch()` with error handling and optimistic updates.","quote":"Actions: `startTransition` can now accept async functions."},{"text":"`useActionState` is a new hook that gives Actions access to their state and pending status.","quote":"`useActionState`: is a new hook to order Actions inside of a Transition with access to the state of the action, and the pending state."},{"text":"Form Actions via the `<form> action` prop manage forms automatically and integrate with the new `useFormStatus` hook.","quote":"`<form> action` prop: Form Actions allow you to manage forms automatically and integrate with `useFormStatus`."},{"text":"`ref` can be passed as a prop, so `forwardRef` is no longer needed.","quote":"`ref` as a prop: Refs can now be used as props, removing the need for `forwardRef`."},{"text":"React Server Components features such as directives, server components, and server functions are now stable.","quote":"RSC features such as directives, server components, and server functions are now stable."}],"breakingChanges":[{"change":"`propTypes` are silently ignored.","migration":"Migrate to TypeScript or another type-checking solution.","quote":"Removed: `propTypes`: Using `propTypes` will now be silently ignored."},{"change":"`ReactDOM.render` and `ReactDOM.hydrate` are removed.","migration":"Use `ReactDOM.createRoot` and `ReactDOM.hydrateRoot` instead.","quote":"Removed: `ReactDOM`.`render`, `ReactDOM`.`hydrate`: These have been removed in favor of the concurrent equivalents: `ReactDOM`.`createRoot` and `ReactDOM.hydrateRoot`."},{"change":"`unmountComponentAtNode` is removed.","migration":"Call `root.unmount()` on the root instead.","quote":"Removed: `unmountComponentAtNode`: Removed in favor of `root.unmount()`."},{"change":"`ReactDOM.findDOMNode` is removed.","migration":"Replace it with DOM Refs.","quote":"Removed: `ReactDOM`.`findDOMNode`: You can replace `ReactDOM`.`findDOMNode` with DOM Refs."},{"change":"Legacy Context for class components (`contextTypes` and `getChildContext`) is removed.","migration":"Use the `contextType` API instead.","quote":"Removed: `contextTypes` and `getChildContext`: Legacy Context for class components has been removed in favor of the `contextType` API."},{"change":"String refs are removed.","migration":"Migrate string refs to ref callbacks.","quote":"Removed: string refs: Any usage of string refs need to be migrated to ref callbacks."},{"change":"The new JSX transform is now required.","migration":"Configure your build to use the new JSX transform.","quote":"New JSX Transform is now required"},{"change":"Errors not caught by an Error Boundary are reported to `window.reportError` instead of being re-thrown.","migration":"Check your error handling and use the `onUncaughtError` and `onCaughtError` options of `createRoot` and `hydrateRoot` to customize it.","quote":"Errors in render are not re-thrown: Errors that are not caught by an Error Boundary are now reported to window.reportError."},{"change":"The global `JSX` namespace is removed.","migration":"Import the JSX namespace from the React package instead: `import { JSX } from 'react'`.","quote":"The global `JSX` namespace is removed to improve interoperability with other libraries using JSX."}]}

vite-8_3_0-beta_0.text: {"actionRequired":false,"notesJudgeable":true,"title":"Adds a top-level tsconfig option, closeServer hooks and style tag minification, plus several bug fixes.","keyPoints":[{"text":"A new top-level `tsconfig` option is available.","quote":"add top-level `tsconfig` option"},{"text":"Plugins can now use `closeServer` and `closePreviewServer` hooks.","quote":"add closeServer and closePreviewServer hooks"},{"text":"The `style` tag CSS is now minified.","quote":"minify style tag"},{"text":"Search params attached to workers are now preserved.","quote":"searched params attached to workers are now preserved"},{"text":"Assets referenced in JS can use `import.meta.ROLLDOWN_FILE_URL_*`.","quote":"use `import.meta.ROLLDOWN_FILE_URL_*` for assets in JS"}],"breakingChanges":[]}

eslint-10_9_1.text: {"actionRequired":false,"notesJudgeable":true,"title":"This patch fixes a false positive in no-loss-of-precision for trailing decimal points, with no breaking changes.","keyPoints":[{"text":"The `no-loss-of-precision` rule no longer reports a false positive for numbers with a trailing decimal point.","quote":"fix: no-loss-of-precision false positive with trailing decimal point (#21251) (Aleksandr Shoronov)"},{"text":"The docs gained deprecation steps for end-of-life package versions.","quote":"docs: add deprecation steps for EOL package versions (#21248) (Francesco Trotta)"},{"text":"Ecosystem plugins were updated to newer versions.","quote":"chore: update ecosystem plugins (#21249) (ESLint Bot)"}],"breakingChanges":[]}

react-19_2_7.text: {"actionRequired":false,"notesJudgeable":true,"title":"React 19.2.7 fixes missing FormData entries in Server Actions that regressed in 19.2.6.","keyPoints":[{"text":"This patch fixes missing `FormData` entries in Server Actions for React Server Components.","quote":"Fixed missing `FormData` entries in Server Actions which regressed in 19.2.6"},{"text":"The bug was a regression introduced in 19.2.6, so users on that version are affected.","quote":"which regressed in 19.2.6"},{"text":"The fix was contributed by @unstubbable in PR #36566.","quote":"(@unstubbable [#36566](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/36566))"}],"breakingChanges":[]}

zod-4_6_0.text: {"actionRequired":true,"notesJudgeable":true,"title":"Zod 4.6 adds `.validate()` and `z.iban()` but changes emoji, enum, email and JSON Schema behavior.","keyPoints":[{"text":"Adds `.validate()` for boolean input checks that skip building a `ZodError`, and it is also a method on Zod Classic schemas.","quote":"It is a method on Zod Classic schemas too."},{"text":"Adds `z.fromJSONSchema()` support for six keywords that were previously ignored.","quote":"Six additional JSON Schema keywords are now supported in `z.fromJSONSchema()`."},{"text":"Adds `z.iban()`, which checks the electronic IBAN format and its mod-97 checksum.","quote":"A new string format: an IBAN in electronic format, with a valid ISO 7064 MOD 97-10 checksum."},{"text":"Fixes a 4.5 out-of-memory regression by releasing the parsed input in recursive schemas.","quote":"Zod 4.4 released that input and Zod 4.5 did not, which surfaced as an out-of-memory failure on a repository-wide lint run."},{"text":"Speeds up `z.validate()` under `require` by about 3x on compiled schemas.","quote":"The 4.6 build emits plain properties and freezes the exports object."}],"breakingChanges":[{"change":"Error maps run when `result.error` is first read, not at parse time, so a config swap in between changes the messages.","migration":"Read `result.error` before changing `z.config()` if the parse-time configuration matters, and do not rely on error map side effects that never run because the error is never read.","quote":"Because `safeParse()` now builds its error lazily, error maps — global, locale, and per-schema `error` — run when `result.error` is first read, not at parse time."},{"change":"`z.emoji()` now rejects strings made only of emoji components, such as digits, `#`, `*`, or modifiers.","migration":"Check inputs that could be only digits, `#`, `*`, or modifier characters, since they are now rejected.","quote":"The pattern now requires at least one pictograph, regional indicator, or keycap."},{"change":"`.options` on a numeric TypeScript enum no longer includes the reverse-mapping keys.","migration":"Do not rely on `.options` containing the reverse-mapping keys; it now lists only the member values.","quote":"so a three-member enum listed six values and three of them failed to parse."},{"change":"The email pattern string changed everywhere it is exposed, including `z.regexes.email`, `issue.pattern`, and the JSON Schema `pattern`.","migration":"Update code that reads capture groups from `z.regexes.email` or matches the old `issue.pattern` or JSON Schema `pattern` string.","quote":"The pattern string is user-visible, and every copy of it changes"},{"change":"Metadata members such as `.minLength` and `.format` are no longer own properties on schema instances until they are first read.","migration":"Do not rely on these keys appearing in `Object.keys()` or `Object.assign()` output on schemas; read the member first if you need it.","quote":"are computed from the checks now instead of being written onto every instance at construction."},{"change":"JSON Schema output for chained checks now folds all bounds together, so the emitted bounds can differ from 4.5.","migration":"Re-check any stored or published JSON Schema generated from chained checks, since bounds now reflect all checks rather than whichever was written last.","quote":"The converter folds the checks as a conjunction now."}]}
